name: Состояние мира едет в пакете
_: The world state channel end to end, without the game. Every step says the SAME phrase and changes only the world: what has to differ between the steps is the reading in the packet and nothing else. The reading is taken when the utterance is taken in, so a step that changes the world after the fact would change nothing - which is the property this scenario is here to hold on to.

steps._: Nothing is open and nothing is paused: the plain case.
The dialogue window is open. The name is the one the settings list, not one written in here.
Paused beats everything: with the world stopped there is no dialogue to be in, even with the menu still open.
